posts.title: You Are Your Accomplishments, Not Your Actions
posts.description: Imperative engineers narrate their work as a string of verbs they perform — I push, I deploy, I run the migration — and when the verb finishes, the sentence is over and they walk away. posts.title: People Are Not Cattle
posts.description: The 'replaceable cog' theory of management is the cattle model applied to humans — interchangeable, nameless, swap any one for another. It's true exactly as far as the work is a stateless, commodity replica. Your best people are not. posts.description: We took the software-engineering playbook — DRY, long-lived feature branches, package managers, dynamic in-cluster orchestration — and pointed it wholesale at running infrastructure.
